feedback: Pre-race review of the iteration 10 candidate. It resubmits the iteration 9 design unchanged: narrow five-sensor array at x = 0.03, 0.015, 0, -0.015, -0.03 with y = 0.05, sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.1, kp 1.8, kd 0.3, ki 0, last_direction, and sensor_weights [2,1,0,-1,-2]. It is the best raced design at 403.3, up from 366.7 in iteration 8. The oval finished 20 of 20 with line_loss_events 0.15 and max_error 0.038, both better than iteration 8. The s-bend improved in progress (0.55 vs 0.34) but its line loss rose from 1.0 to 2.0, and it still finished 0 of 20. Slalom progress fell from 0.17 to 0.10 with line loss at 1.0. The candidate is valid, within contract limits, and not a stacked change, so it is the right baseline to race. A further revision would cost two action runs, and the one-variable alternatives (kp 1.6, or reverting the footprint) are already covered by the requested changes below, so approving now gives the clearest telemetry. Next race, interpreted as follows. If the oval holds at 20 of 20 with line loss near 0.15 to 0.3 and the s-bend line loss stays at 2.0, the footprint may be blending readings on tight bends, so the next revision should test kp 1.6 alone with sensor_size 0.016 held. If the s-bend or slalom line loss falls below 1.0 while the oval holds, keep the design and test a single further change. If the oval completion drops below 18 of 20 or the oval max_error rises above 0.044, revert sensor_size to 0.012 with kp 1.8, since that is the iteration 8 baseline.
requested_changes: If the s-bend line_loss_events stay at 2.0 while the oval holds at 20 of 20, make a single change to kp 1.6 with sensor_size 0.016 held, since the kp trend (2.5 to 2.0 to 1.8) cut line loss on every track and iteration 9's s-bend progress rose to 0.55.

If the oval completion falls below 18 of 20 or oval max_error rises above 0.044, revert sensor_size to 0.012 and keep kp 1.8, base_speed 1.1 and kd 0.3, since iteration 8 (sensor_size 0.012) is the fallback baseline at 366.7.

Keep the five-sensor spacing (x = 0.03, 0.015, 0, -0.015, -0.03), sensor_weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], kd 0.3, ki 0 and last_direction unchanged, since iteration 2 (22.5 mm spacing) dropped the score to 81.1 and iteration 7 (kd 0.25) dropped it to 163.3.
